meta.title: Merge main into mobile with Appium performance optimizations
meta.body_summary: Merge main branch into mobile while optimizing Appium thread pool, screenshot execution, LLM chat rounds, and chat log I/O; added multiple performance test scripts and documentation.

perf_labels.notes: Devin merged main into mobile with multiple performance claims; no human review, closed by bot after 7 days inactivity.

The PR added numerous new test/performance scripts, but lacked human verification; it fits a moderate incremental performance PR that was closed without review due to inactivity.

core_change_summary.description: Merged main branch into mobile while optimizing Appium thread pool (30→CPU-based then 2-3), adding direct screenshot path, reducing LLM chat rounds (500→50, 10→5), and disabling chat logs by default; also added multiple performance test scripts and documentation.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Numerous new test scripts and performance docs were added but not referenced in review.
change_trajectory: Initial commit merged main, optimized thread pool, added direct screenshot path, and test/import verification scripts.
Second commit added null safety for iOS gestures.
Third commit further reduced LLM chat rounds, further thread pool to 2-3, disabled chat logs, and added comprehensive mobile performance test suite.

review_signals.summary: Devin bot announced automatic comment/CI monitoring.
Closing due to inactivity for more than 7 days.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with merge and initial performance optimizations; no human review requested apparently (no review_requested event).
Two more commits by Devin adding further optimizations and tests.
After 9 days with no human comments, Devin bot auto-closed the PR for inactivity.
